The [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Tenebrae]] was born in a '''village''' on the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] of [[Nathema|Medriaas]] in [[5113 BBY]]. The village was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] remote [[Nathema's northern continent|northern continent]], far from his father, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Dramath]]. Tenebrae [[Death/Legends|killed]] his [[Tenebrae's mother|mother]] and [[Tenebrae's adoptive father|adoptive father]] when he was six and began to torture the other villagers as he took control of the surrounding region, and the village was largely demolished when he built his [[Vitiate's palace|palace]] in [[5100 BBY/Legends|5100 BBY]] after becoming Lord Vitiate and renaming the planet Nathema.<ref name="Revan" />
